hero.eyebrow: Open-source ERP for shops and distributors
hero.title: Every rupee and every unit,
hero.lead: Stock, sales, purchasing, books and payroll for small businesses. Every document posts its own double-entry journal, so your trial balance is right the moment the sale is.

promises.title: The forms are easy. These are not.

items.title: Books that always balance
items.body: Debits equal credits before anything is saved. Posted entries never change; corrections are reversals and credit notes.

items.title: Stock that stays right
items.body: Two cashiers selling the last item at the same moment cannot both succeed. Stock levels change only under row locks.

items.title: Businesses that never meet
items.body: One installation, many businesses. Every query is scoped to one of them, and a test calls every endpoint as an outsider.

ledger.title: Watch an invoice become accounting.
ledger.body: A sale of 12 cartons moves stock out of the warehouse and writes a balanced journal entry in the same database transaction. If any step fails, nothing is saved.

modules.eyebrow: Everything a counter and a back office need
modules.title: Modules
modules.lead: Each module ships with its screens, its posting rules and its tests.

items.title: Inventory
items.body: Variants, units, warehouses, transfers, batches with expiry dates, FIFO or moving average.

items.title: Sales
items.body: Quotations, orders, invoices, receipts, returns, credit notes and customer credit limits.

items.title: Point of sale
items.body: Barcode scan, cash and card, printed receipts and an end-of-day close.

items.title: Purchasing
items.body: Suppliers, purchase orders, goods received, bills and supplier payments.

items.title: Accounting
items.body: Chart of accounts, fiscal periods, journal entries, trial balance and ledgers.

items.title: Tax
items.body: Rates as dated data, tax on every line, and a GST or VAT report for any period.

items.title: HR
items.body: Employees, departments, contracts, attendance and leave on working days.

items.title: Payroll
items.body: Monthly runs, deductions, income tax from slabs per tax year, and payslips.

languages.title: Speaks the way your shop speaks.
languages.body: English, Urdu and Arabic in every screen and every printed invoice, with right-to-left layouts where they belong.

security.title: Your books are nobody else's business.
security.lead: What protects your data, in plain words.

items.title: Fail-closed tenancy
items.body: Queries without an active business raise an error instead of returning everyone's rows. Another business's record answers 404.

items.title: Sessions, not tokens in the browser
items.body: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies with CSRF checks on every change, including sign-in itself.

items.title: Argon2id passwords
items.body: Memory-hard hashing, a 12 character minimum, and common passwords refused.

items.title: Rate limits everywhere
items.body: Every endpoint has a throttle, with strict ones on sign-in, sign-up and password reset, plus limits at the proxy.

items.title: Content Security Policy
items.body: A fresh nonce on every response and strict-dynamic, so injected scripts do not run.

items.title: Row locks and one lock order
items.body: Stock, numbering and balances are read and written under SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, always in primary key order.

items.title: An audit trail
items.body: Every create, update, post and delete writes who, what, when and the request it came from.

items.title: Nothing leaks in errors
items.body: Unexpected errors return a request id and nothing else. The details stay in the server log.

security.report: Found a problem? Report it privately through GitHub security advisories or support@ahmershah.dev.

cta.title: Open source, MIT licensed.
cta.body: Read every line, run it on your own server, or follow along as it is built.

footer.tagline: Built for the counter, the back office and the books.
footer.ctaBody: Create a business in a minute. Your chart of accounts and first fiscal year are ready when you are.

auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, easy password.
auth.checkEmailBody: If {{email}} can be used, a confirmation link is on its way. It works for 3 days.
auth.badLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
auth.resetSent: If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way.
auth.passwordChanged: Your password is changed and other sessions are signed out.
auth.joinBody: You are signed in as {{email}}. Accept the invitation to join.

workspace.newBusinessBody: Each business has its own books, stock and staff. You will be its owner.
workspace.unverified: Confirm your email to create a business or accept invitations.
workspace.comingNextBody: Chart of accounts, journal entries and the trial balance arrive with milestone M2.
workspace.rolesBody: A role is a set of permissions per module. Owners can always do everything.
workspace.auditBody: Every change to this business, who made it and when.
workspace.valuationHint: How stock is costed when it leaves. It can't be changed once stock has moved.

manifesto.body: Most small businesses run on paper registers and spreadsheets that slowly drift apart. Karobar keeps stock, sales and books in one ledger, so every number agrees with every other the moment anything happens.

acc.journalBody: Every entry in the books. Drafts can change; posted entries can only be reversed.
acc.draftHint: Drafts can be saved unbalanced. Posting checks the balance, the period and the accounts, then gives the entry its number.
acc.chartBody: Groups total their accounts; entries go to the accounts inside them.
acc.name: Name
acc.trialBalanceBody: Every account's balance. Debits and credits always match.
acc.ledgerBody: Every posted line of one account, with the running balance.
acc.periodsBody: Close a month once its books are final; closed periods take no new entries.

inv.productsBody: What you buy and sell, the units it comes in and its barcodes.
inv.needUnits: Add a unit such as PCS under Inventory setup first.
inv.entriesBody: Receipts, issues, transfers and counts. Posting moves stock and books its cost.

kindHelp.receipt: Stock coming in without a supplier bill, such as opening stock. Enter what each unit cost.
kindHelp.issue: Stock leaving without a sale: damage, samples, own use. It leaves at cost.
kindHelp.transfer: Move stock between warehouses. Cost moves with it; the books don't change.
kindHelp.adjustment: Enter what you counted. The difference is booked as found or lost stock.

inv.onHandBody: What every warehouse holds and what it is worth in the books.
inv.alertsBody: Products below their reorder level and batches expiring within 30 days. Owners get this by email each morning.
inv.setupBody: Units of measure and the warehouses you keep stock in.
